items.title: Chester Jones Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] On yours? Oh, Bill Russell is there.

ctx.x: Let me put a little something on here first. We're recording today at 731 St. Peter, Bill Russell's home in Rekacha. Let's see, what's today's date? July... Is it the 10th? I think it's the 10th. It's Monday anyway. Yeah, the 10th. July the 10th, 1961. And what's your name? Chester Jones. Chester Jones. And my name is Dick Allen. Let's see. I guess I've known you about 11 years now, but we might as well go back long before that. Oh, yeah. Might as well start at the beginning. Yeah. Where were you born? I think I…

Down the river, in other words, on the other side. That's right. Well, I left there. Parents said they'd take me from here when I was a year old. Stayed at 1115 St. Phil Street. I was stood there for about 15 to 20 years or maybe better. Left there and we moved down in the night war down on Law Street. Bought a home down there. Still there for a while. They'd come back to the same old house again. I don't know if it's at St. Phil but 15th, 1115 St. Phil Street. Stood there again about, I'd say about 10 years.…
